scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names API,WEB --prefix-colors cyan,magenta "npm --prefix backend run start:dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.lint: npm --prefix backend run lint && npm --prefix frontend run lint && npm --prefix integration-tests run lint
scripts.format: npm --prefix backend run format && npm --prefix frontend run format && npm --prefix integration-tests run format
scripts.format:check: npm --prefix backend run format:check && npm --prefix frontend run format:check && npm --prefix integration-tests run format:check
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend test && npm --prefix frontend test && npm --prefix frontend run test:components && npm --prefix integration-tests run test
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm test
